selection: Twenty historical and twenty current merged Rust-source PRs fixed by source category before cost collection. This excludes open/abandoned PRs and unretained history; it is not the full population of attempted work.

units.runnerSeconds: Unweighted recorded job occupancy, excluding unknown intervals; not billing or CPU time.
units.runnerMinutes: Sum of known physical job seconds / 60 with job-ID deduplication.
units.phaseMinutes: Original event wall clocks; includes validation/decisions/dispatch and does not isolate runner capacity.

scope: Main pushes at the exact accepted merge SHA
limits: Original source strata and both fixed selections retained. Historical sources already include early CI changes.
Exact accepted-merge main push jobs supplement PR/queue/publisher jobs; every original attempt is included once per physical job ID.
Source-branch push, periodic/manual/tag/release, unbound publishers and unretained author work are not silently zero.
Unknown historical intervals and queue/branch associations remain. An unknown interval is never substituted by billing zero.
Different source, coverage and policy epochs prevent interpreting median ratios as controlled or universal savings.
Source, coverage and policy epochs differ; historical PRs already include early optimizations.
The fixed cohort contains merged PRs only. Do not infer cost for all attempted/open/abandoned work.
Some queued placeholders have creation-like started_at values. Unknown runnerSeconds are retained as null; skipped jobs retain the original zero classification.
Periodic/manual/tag/release and one-time policy repair work need separate accounting; no equally allocated amortization is assumed.
Author-host and overlapping local invocation spans are separate evidence and are not added to hosted occupancy.
An original event labeled closed is retained when authoritative PR metadata proves merged; clock discrepancies and original phase event kinds remain.
physicalJobStorage: Rows preserve source ID/run/attempt, conclusion, original timing and a boolean nonempty-runner assignment flag, in column order. No runner machine name is published.
measurementRule: Unassigned skipped job: 0. Assigned job with both timestamps: max(0, completed_at minus started_at). Otherwise unknown/null. This preserves the original recorded lower-bound classifier; it is not billed or active CPU time.

retainedPublicInputRefusal.reason: Timestamp-only recomputation rejected. This canceled row has no assigned runner; its recorded 28m29s placeholder span is not measured occupancy.

sourceMixSensitivity.method: Descriptive direct standardization of known per-PR runner minutes to each fixed cohort source-stratum mix; all original physical jobs retained once. Leave-one-out removes each single PR in turn and recomputes the ratio of means.
limits: Descriptive arithmetic on fixed unmatched samples; not a randomized comparison or a confidence interval.
Four coarse strata do not match runtime effects, source size, cache, runner or validation policy.
Unknown physical-job costs remain unknown; failed, cancelled and post-merge known jobs stay included.
Standardization changes sample weights only; it does not prove source-equivalent or unchanged-coverage improvement.
Queue, local author, active engineering, periodic and library investment remain separate costs.
